Houghton Physical Therapy offers customized, one-on-one treatment and rehabilitation of orthopedic, neurological, work-related, and motor vehicle injuries. We offer a modern 3200sq. ft. facility, private treatment rooms, state-of-the-art equipment, and a passion for healing.
Many people are unaware that they do not have to live with chronic pain, such as headaches, back, and neck pain, and foot pain. Physical therapy can successfully treat these common daily ailments along with many other types of injuries, like sprains, strains, fractures, pre/post-surgical conditions, and sports injuries. Houghton Physical Therapy works with your body to increase strength, flexibility, and tolerance of everyday activities. This channel is a visual platform designed to educate people on how to take preventative measures to avoid injury through an active lifestyle and develop healthy daily habits to have more energy and longevity in life!
